description: This file contains documentation for the `TestStep` class used in Playwright's test reporter API. It provides detailed descriptions of properties and methods of the class related to test step representation, including timing, categorization, location, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TestStep
classes.description: Represents a step in a test run, including properties such as category, duration, location, error, parent, startTime, nested steps, annotations, attachments, title, and methods for accessing step hierarchy.

methods.name: TestStep.titlePath
methods.description: Returns the list of step titles from the root to this step, useful for understanding the hierarchy of nested steps.
